pr.body: Final packet in the DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL series. Re-enables search_decisions and search_progress in services/dcp-readonly-facade/src/dcp_facade/tools.py by removing the 500/auto-fork workarounds added before ConPort search was stable. Adds a get_linked_items reader in services/dcp-readonly-facade/src/dcp_facade/conport.py that calls GET /api/relationships (read-only). Adds integration tests in services/dcp-readonly-facade/tests/test_facade_search_integration.py covering search_decisions, search_progress, and get_linked_items against a stubbed ConPort. Unknown ConPort errors are mapped to 502. Does not alter the facade route manifest or DCP denylist. Depends on 102 (ConPort 500 fixes), 107 (Redis cache), and 202 (entity-relationship read surface).
